rows.grounds: compound śālā-ānana-upeta; accusative singular neuter adjective
neuter nominative singular adjective used as predicate name

items.question: If the outer structure is endowed with a hall-face, what is it called?
premises: Such a structure is called raudra.
The condition is introduced by yadi.
items.inference: Therefore an outer hall-faced structure is termed raudra.
uncertainties: The exact architectural referent of śālānanopetaṃ remains uncertain.
items.plain_english: If it is outside and endowed with a hall-face, it is called raudra.
